nodes.label: Frozen Finite Pilot Menu Contract
nodes.statement: Before pilot outcomes, freeze a finite menu of confirmatory plans, each containing N_q, one constant bet and constant center per component, the unchanged R161 target/decision/gates, a deterministic tie-break, alpha, beta, transport radii, width objective, resource cap and status boundaries; confirmatory outcomes may not select the plan, target or report.
nodes.domain: One fixed R161/R164 bounded protocol, finite nonempty menu after deterministic resource screening, external pilot and disjoint confirmatory sample; no pilot or human study occurred.
nodes.scope: One fixed R161/R164 bounded protocol, finite nonempty menu after deterministic resource screening, external pilot and disjoint confirmatory sample; no pilot or human study occurred.
nodes.source_lineage: R162 external-pilot freeze plus R164 constant-bet target discipline, made finite and auditable for width selection.
nodes.proof: Definition; it fixes the selector's range and all decision inputs before pilot/confirmatory outcomes.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A finite menu may omit every scientifically useful plan. Freezing does not validate apparatus, participant independence, transport radii or experience-level interpretation.

formal_contract_R165.object_domain: One fixed R161 bounded body/tool protocol, its R162 external pilot and R164 constant-bet interval family; no human work occurred.
formal_contract_R165.quantifiers: Finite m and menu Q, every component-plan pair, every pilot record, every selected plan, finite n_P and N_q, and fixed alpha/beta/width/resource thresholds.
formal_contract_R165.bearer_time_signature: Pilot and confirmatory participants, menu plans, statistical targets, actual process tokens, complete organizations, experiences and reports remain differently typed and temporally ordered.
formal_contract_R165.purpose: Close the pilot-selection loophole without target change, confirmatory reuse, false infeasibility or experience-level promotion.

nodes.label: Pilot Selection Preserves Planwise Coverage
nodes.statement: Any pilot-measurable deterministic selector from the frozen finite menu preserves R164 simultaneous coverage at level 1-alpha when every selected plan satisfies the R162 planwise premise and uses constant confirmatory bets for the same unweighted finite-design target; menu size is not charged to alpha because exactly one independent-pilot-selected plan is executed.
nodes.domain: Every pilot record and every selected plan in the fixed menu, with disjoint confirmatory data and all R164 boundedness, target, predictability and participant-independence premises.
nodes.scope: Every pilot record and every selected plan in the fixed menu, with disjoint confirmatory data and all R164 boundedness, target, predictability and participant-independence premises.
nodes.source_lineage: R162 tower theorem specialized to the R164 constant-bet finite menu.
nodes.proof: Condition on the pilot record, apply the planwise guarantee to the frozen selected plan, and integrate over pilot records. Constant bets preserve the unweighted target plan by plan.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Selecting from confirmatory outcomes can inflate error; menu finiteness does not repair an invalid plan. The theorem says nothing about precision or feasibility.

nodes.label: Pilot Independence Does Not Transport Width
nodes.statement: Disjoint pilot and confirmatory samples can be independent while reversing the residual-risk ranking of two predictor centers; therefore pilot independence transports planwise coverage but does not identify confirmatory residual risks, expected widths or the width-optimal plan.
nodes.domain: One bounded component, two constant centers, one common constant bet and independent deterministic pilot/confirmatory laws.
nodes.scope: One bounded component, two constant centers, one common constant bet and independent deterministic pilot/confirmatory laws.
nodes.source_lineage: New protocol-specific counterexample using elementary squared residuals; no new general probability theory claimed.
nodes.proof: Pilot X=0 ranks center 0 ahead of center 1; independent confirmatory X=1 ranks center 1 ahead of center 0. The target and constant bet remain unchanged.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: It does not challenge interval coverage. A defended transport/stability premise or worst-case bound can restore a width statement.

nodes.label: Pilot-to-Confirmation Residual Transport Premise
nodes.statement: For every component-plan pair, the absolute difference between the finite-pilot-design and finite-confirmatory-design expected squared residual risks is at most the predeclared nonnegative radius tau_jq.
nodes.domain: Every component and plan in the frozen menu, fixed pilot and confirmatory designs, constant centers, and explicitly declared sensitivity radii.
nodes.scope: Every component and plan in the frozen menu, fixed pilot and confirmatory designs, constant centers, and explicitly declared sensitivity radii.
nodes.source_lineage: Premise isolated by the R165 nonidentification counterexample; not imported from Hoeffding, independence or C1.
nodes.proof: No proof is claimed. The radius is a sensitivity/design assumption to be independently justified or varied.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The zero-pilot/one-confirmatory counterexample violates every radius below one for the corresponding center. Large radii can make the certificate uninformative.

nodes.label: Pilot Width and Regret Certificate
nodes.statement: For bounded independent pilot participant vectors, a finite frozen menu and valid residual-transport radii, simultaneous Hoeffding bands cover every confirmatory residual risk with probability at least 1-beta; minimizing the resulting upper expected-width certificate has regret at most max_j 4g(lambda_jq*)[b+tau_jq*]/lambda_jq* relative to the true menu oracle q*.
nodes.domain: Finite m and menu, bounded pilot squared residuals, independent pilot participant vectors, fixed N_q/lambda/c, valid transport radii and the maximum component expected untruncated half-width objective.
nodes.scope: Finite m and menu, bounded pilot squared residuals, independent pilot participant vectors, fixed N_q/lambda/c, valid transport radii and the maximum component expected untruncated half-width objective.
nodes.source_lineage: Hoeffding bounded-mean union bound plus R164's affine expected-width formula and deterministic upper-certificate minimization.
nodes.proof: Uniformly bound pilot risks, add declared transport radii, use monotonicity of the affine width formula, and compare the selected upper certificate to the true oracle's certificate.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The result fails without transport, is menu-relative, may be loose, and does not certify realized width, power, apparatus or experience.

nodes.label: Certified Feasible, Inconclusive, or Menu-Relative Infeasible
nodes.statement: After R161 gates and hard resource screening, min_q H_U(q)<=w_max certifies feasibility, min_q H_L(q)>w_max certifies menu-relative DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE at width confidence 1-beta, and all remaining cases are PILOT_INCONCLUSIVE; an upper bound above threshold alone never proves infeasibility.
nodes.domain: A nonempty deterministically admissible R165 menu, simultaneous lower/upper width certificate, fixed w_max and beta; R161 gate failures are evaluated separately.
nodes.scope: A nonempty deterministically admissible R165 menu, simultaneous lower/upper width certificate, fixed w_max and beta; R161 gate failures are evaluated separately.
nodes.source_lineage: Order logic applied to the R165 simultaneous width band, with R161/R162 invalidity and resource boundaries retained.
nodes.proof: On H_L(q)<=H(q)<=H_U(q) for all plans, an upper certificate below threshold provides a witness; every lower certificate above threshold excludes every menu plan; the complementary region proves neither statement.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The status is relative to menu, objective, transport radii, resource cap and beta. It is not global study impossibility, theoretical exclusion, no mineness or no experience.

rules.statement: The explicit planwise premise, R164 constant-bet coverage and frozen finite-menu contract jointly imply that independent pilot selection preserves coverage and the unweighted target.
rules.proof_sketch: Condition on every pilot record, apply the selected plan's R164 guarantee, then integrate; constant bets preserve the planwise target.

bindings_required: same fixed R161/R164 target and components
every menu plan is planwise valid
constant bets within every confirmatory plan
selector and tie-break depend only on pilot record
no confirmatory-outcome family/target/report selection
population coverage remains distinct from actual organization and experience
formal_contract_R165.quantification: Every pilot record and every plan in the selector's range must satisfy all premises simultaneously.

rules.statement: R164's width formula, the finite menu and the separately declared residual-transport premise jointly yield simultaneous pilot width bounds and the menu-relative upper-certificate regret result.
rules.proof_sketch: Union-bound Hoeffding pilot risks, add transport radii, use affine width monotonicity, and compare the selected upper certificate with the true oracle.

bindings_required: same bounded squared-residual objects
finite menu frozen before pilot outcomes
independent pilot participant vectors
valid declared transport radius for every component-plan pair
maximum component expected untruncated half-width objective
beta kept separate from confirmatory alpha
no apparatus or experience-level promotion
formal_contract_R165.quantification: Every component-plan pair must satisfy boundedness and its declared transport inequality simultaneously.

rules.statement: The physical/measurement admissibility gate, frozen menu/status contract and simultaneous width band jointly imply the honest feasible/inconclusive/menu-relative-infeasible trichotomy.
rules.proof_sketch: Apply the lower/true/upper ordering to every plan after protocol and hard-resource screening; the two strict certification conditions are disjoint and the complement is inconclusive.

bindings_required: all six R161 gates evaluated before width status
hard resource envelope frozen
nonempty admissible menu or deterministic infeasibility
simultaneous H_L<=H<=H_U event
fixed w_max and beta
PILOT_INVALID_PROTOCOL, PILOT_INCONCLUSIVE, DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE and confirmatory UNRESOLVED remain distinct
no status-to-mineness/experience inference
formal_contract_R165.quantification: Every admissible menu plan and all fixed status boundaries must be evaluated in the same protocol version.
